title: Design file for the symbolic system models
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.51.1 (maintainer 2026-10-26): docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md - the assembly by the local-to-global maps of systemData, sparse matrices, the export of the equations of motion and their evaluation by Numba or on the GPU with explicit integration (residuals per object), an implicit generalized-alpha solver in Python with the settings of SimulationSettings, compared against the internal solvers, and the Jacobians by esym.Diff.
releaseNotes: docs/dev/design/symbolicSystem.md: the design of symbolic system models - per object flat programs grouped by kind, assembly by the local-to-global maps into sparse triplets, export and Numba/GPU evaluation with explicit integration from residuals, a generalized-alpha solver in Python checked against the internal solvers, and Jacobians by symbolic differentiation; sub-steps and decisions proposed.
